newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sachsen LB says wins long-term AAA IBCA rating. [corrected 08:43 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Sachsen LB says wins long-term AAA IBCA rating. [corrected 08:43 gmt]

text.p: Germany's Sachsen LB Landesbank Sachsen Girozentrale said on Friday it had been assigned a long-term AAA rating and short-term A1 plus rating by IBCA, the European credit rating agency.
The bank said the ratings meant Sachsen now officially belonged to the group of issuers with "exceptionally good capability" for the repayment of debt and interest.
Sachsen said in a statement that IBCA had also awarded it a legal rating 1 and an individual rating of B/C (corrects from "rating of C/D").
